podcast.title: Appearance on Alan Freed Tour
podcast.body: Larry Williams was one of the eleven acts, alongside Chuck Berry, Buddy Holly, The Chantels, and Jerry Lee Lewis, on the legendary Alan Freed tour. "It was around this time that Jerry Lee went on the Alan Fried tour that we mentioned last week, with Chuck Berry, Buddy Holly, Larry Williams, the Chantel's, and Eleven Other Act."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 66: "Great Balls of Fire" by Jerry Lee Lewis

podcast.title: Backstage Anecdote at Paramount (Year not specified)
podcast.body: During a residency at the Brooklyn Paramount on an Alan Fried show, Larry Williams and Little Richard were discovered engaged in a threesome with Richard's girlfriend when The Crickets entered their dressing room. "Richard and Williams engaged in a threesome with Richard's girlfriend."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 74: "It Doesn't Matter Any More" by Buddy Holly

podcast.title: Significant Influence on Richie Valens
podcast.body: Larry Williams' R&B music was a major source of inspiration and interest for Richie Valens during his high school years, alongside Little Richard. Both artists were known for recording on Specialty Records, shaping Valens' musical preferences. "Valens' big interest in school was music, especially R&B, and especially the music of Little Richard and Larry Williams, and other people who had recorded for specialty records."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
